record.body:
## Description

R1: `ci.yml` has a job named `wheel`.
R2: The `wheel` job does not set `continue-on-error`.
R3: No step in the `wheel` job sets `continue-on-error`.
R4: The `wheel` job runs `python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py`.
R21: `README.md` names `python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py` as the local wheel check.

## Approach

In `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, add a `wheel` job with the same shape as `types`: `ubuntu-latest`, `timeout-minutes`, `actions/checkout@v4`, and `astral-sh/setup-uv@v6` with `python-version: "3.10"` and `enable-cache: true` (`ci-python-version`). Do not set `continue-on-error` on the job or any step. Do not set `needs`. The only `run` step is `python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py`. Do not `uv sync` first; the script builds and installs the wheel itself.

In `README.md`, under Testing, after the Type check subsection, add a short Wheel check paragraph that names `python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py` and says the `wheel` job runs the same command.

Leave the oracle tests in `tests/test_ci_workflow.py` unchanged. Existing tests already require every job to set `timeout-minutes`, use Python 3.10, enable the uv cache, and stay blocking.
